First Saturday Ocean Springs Community Ride (Tato-Nut)

Ocean Springs, MS · Social

First Saturday Ocean Springs Community Ride (Tato-Nut) is a social group ride in Ocean Springs, MS. It rolls first Saturday of the month at 9:00 am from Little Children's Park, Ocean Springs.

The Gulf Coast Bicycle Club's Ride with GPS calendar lists 'Tri Hard Tatonut in Ocean Springs' for Sat Oct 3, 2026 at 9:00 am (and Nov 7), meeting at Little Children's Park, Dewey and Calhoun; Tri Hard Sports' community page says 'Every first Saturday of the month: Tatonut Ride @ 9:00am'. About the First Saturday Ocean Springs Community Ride (Tato-Nut) group ride

A relaxed family ride through shaded neighborhoods, along the beachfront road and through Gulf Islands National Seashore. Any bike, any age. It follows the Live Oaks Bicycle Trail and is known locally as the Tato-Nut ride, after the donut shop. Confirm the start time with TriHard Sports.
